name: Phoenix on the Bay
description:
Phoenix on the Bay is a waterfront condominium community located along Terry Cove in Orange Beach, Alabama. The property offers a distinctive bayfront setting with views of Terry Cove, Robinson Island, and Perdido Pass, while remaining just a short drive from public beach access.

The property features fully furnished 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom vacation rentals with equipped kitchens and spacious private balconies overlooking the bay and pool areas. With an on-site marina, boat launch, and boat slips
